Subject: Agenda for Thursday's sprint review
Hi all, attached is the agenda for Thursday's sprint review at 10:00 in room 3.12. Please add your demo items to the board by Wednesday evening. Thanks, Maria

Subject: Your order #48213 has shipped
Good news! Your order has shipped and should arrive within 2-3 business days. You can track your package here: https://www.example-shop.com/orders/48213. Thank you for shopping with us.

Subject: Password reset requested
We received a request to reset the password for your account. If you made this request, use the link below within 30 minutes: https://accounts.example.org/reset. If you did not request a reset, you can ignore this email.

Subject: Invoice 2026-1187 for October services
Dear customer, please find attached invoice 2026-1187 for consulting services delivered in October. Payment is due within 30 days to the account stated on the invoice. Kind regards, Accounting

Subject: Planned maintenance of the VPN gateway on Saturday
Dear colleagues, the VPN gateway will be unavailable on Saturday between 06:00 and 08:00 due to planned maintenance. No action is required on your side. IT Operations

Subject: Quick question about the Q3 report
Hey Tom, do you have the final numbers for the Q3 report? I want to double-check the totals in section 4 before I send it to finance tomorrow. Cheers, Anna

Subject: Library opening hours during the winter break
Dear students, the university library will have reduced opening hours from 23 December to 6 January. Online resources remain available as usual.

Subject: Invitation: 1:1 with Sarah, Mon 14:00
Sarah has invited you to a meeting on Monday at 14:00. Join via the link in the calendar invite. Accept or decline in your calendar.

Subject: New sign-in to your account
We noticed a new sign-in to your account from a Mac in Vienna, Austria. If this was you, no action is needed. If not, please review your security settings in the account portal.

Subject: Reminder: submit your timesheet by Friday
Hi everyone, a friendly reminder to submit your timesheets for this month by Friday noon so payroll can be processed on time. Thanks, HR

Subject: Re: Ticket 55120 - printer not working
Hello, thank you for your patience. Our technician will visit your office tomorrow between 9 and 11 to replace the toner unit. Best regards, Support Team

Subject: Your registration for SecCon 2026 is confirmed
Thank you for registering. Your ticket is attached as a PDF. Please bring it on your phone or printed to the registration desk. We look forward to seeing you.
